title: Resonance phenomena in kink antikink collisions within higher order shifted periodic high order models
summary: We investigate kink antikink collisions in higher order scalar field theories described by the higher order models and their shifted periodic extensions. Both classes of models possess three degenerate vacuum states and support topological kink solutions with asymmetric profiles and algebraically decaying tails. By extending conventional polynomial potentials across multiple spatial sectors, we construct shifted periodic high order field theories and examine how this modification affects the scattering dynamics of topological defects.
